import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', '.codex', 'skills', 'docx'))
from scripts.document import Document

doc = Document('unpacked')
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]
paras = editor.dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    pPr = p.getElementsByTagName("w:pPr")
    style = ""
    if pPr:
        pStyle = pPr[0].getElementsByTagName("w:pStyle")
        if pStyle:
            style = pStyle[0].getAttribute("w:val")
    text = "".join(t.firstChild.nodeValue for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r") for t in r.getElementsByTagName("w:t") if t.firstChild)
    if style.startswith("Heading") or style in ("Title", "Subtitle"):
        print(f"[{i}] style={style} text={text!r}")

from defusedxml import minidom

    print(p.toprettyxml(indent="  "))
    print()
